purpose: Teach: 単体/序盤/ワイルド/くわえ/不都合/幾度/当り/きまっ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、おもちゃは単体でも楽しめるよね
lines.en: You know, toys can be fun on their own, don't you think?
lines.style: Gentle, almost to herself. Soft curiosity in her voice. Speaking as much to Sho as to the moment between them. A pause before the question, like she's offering him something to consider.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お話の序盤がお気に入りだよ
lines.en: Mei-sister, I really like the beginning of the story.
lines.style: Bright and earnest. No performance—just a kid who wants to share what he thinks. Quick, direct, the words tumbling out because he trusts her to listen.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのワイルドな笑い方が好きよ
lines.en: You know what I love? The way your dad laughs—so wild and genuine.
lines.style: Warm, noticing. Speaking with the softness of someone who sees something good and names it out loud. Gentle smile in her voice. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ピアスをくわえる真似したよ
lines.en: Mei-sister, I even tried to copy the way he does it with the earring.
lines.style: Proud and a little sheepish. Eager to show her he's paying attention to things. Small, genuine laugh underneath. The honesty of a child who doesn't hide his admiration.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、不都合があったら、メイ姉さんに教えてね
lines.en: If anything feels off or wrong, you'll tell me about it, right?
lines.style: Soft but steady. Not worried, but present. The kind of care that doesn't make a big deal out of itself. Opening with warmth, ending with reassurance she means it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、幾度もお祖父ちゃんに会いに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sister, I've been to see Grandpa so many times now.
lines.style: Bright with quiet pride. Not boasting—just sharing something that matters to him. The satisfaction of someone who's made a choice and kept with it. Open and pleased.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの予想が当りだったわ, 本気で
lines.en: I was right about that, wasn't I? I really was.
lines.style: Pleased recognition, almost to herself at first. Then a glance toward him—soft, knowing. No triumph, just the warmth of a prediction that came true and brought something good.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祭りの日がきまったから楽しみ
lines.en: Mei-sister, the festival date's been set—I can't wait.
lines.style: Bright, unburdened joy. The openness of a child who's excited and wants to share it. Quick, light energy. No hesitation—just pure looking-forward.
